Which search mode should I use?

Choose a mode based on what you need to find.

Available search modes
ModeUse it for
QuickA first pass on a focused question
DeepInvestigating a question across multiple sources
AcademicFinding research papers and their evidence
arXivFinding preprints and following new work

Search, synthesize, read

Collect sources

Aggregate results and extract relevant passages from the retrieved material.

Trace the answer

Stream synthesis with source citations and suggested follow-up queries.

Inspect papers

Use paper metadata, method notes, and the PDF reader to check the original evidence.

Tune the pipeline

Configure search providers and model settings to fit your research workflow.

Run AutoSearch AI

Live queries require the FastAPI backend, search providers and a configured language model. The repository includes local development and Docker Compose instructions.
